name: Asturianos (Spain)
description: Blue field with a chequered band of crimson and white from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged with yellow fleurs-de-lis at the lower hoist and a yellow Victory Cross at the upper fly.
history: Municipal flag of Asturianos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: chequered band of crimson and white from the upper hoist to the lower fly
fleurs-de-lis strewn at the lower hoist
Victory Cross at the upper fly
